notes.title: Missions Update
notes.content:
Attention all Cleaner units,
Operation Survive has reached a major update revolving around the missions, main menu fix, and settings using .json format, UI responsiveness, graphics + sounds

What to expect in this update

 +4 AI Bots (Simplified but they follow and revive)
 2 annihilation missions
 2 mission maps
 Base Menu Update
 Stages 0 and 1 added
 Day and Night on certain maps
 Support Calls (A new system that has been made to call for supplies, weapons or reinforcements)
 Working minimap
 Health and damage balancing
 Optimized (to the best of my ability) for faster FPS


And more to come as we continue the journey!

You can catch video updates on our Youtube Channel at: Griffon Interactive

Stay Safe 
-Griffon Interactive Director



Directors note: The update came a day later than Halloween which was advertised but we missed it due to some bugs that took a day to fix. But otherwise, we are happy to show off what we got for the October-November timeline!
We have been working hard to make this game worthy of the price tag and worthy of our debut in the game development environment. We appreciate not only your feedback but also the time that you have given to support us! 
We will continue to update this game until the day we officially release it, not on Early Access, but officially released!
There are more things to do and as we continue, the updates will be posted. 
Hype is what we need and we would appreciate it if you could give us your support from you and or friends and family!

notes.title: Prepare for certain drop!
notes.content:
Attention all Cleaner units, Hunter Project Operation Survive will be launching soon! 
The last nail for Early Access Release is the tutorial mission

Things that are noteworthy:

 Ammo Boxes have been created and added to each available Survival Map
 Tutorial mission has a start and end cutscene
 Tutorial mission has a partially scripted story with some voice acting
 You can change your weapons to either the AR, SMG, or Shotgun (sniper has not been implemented)
 AI bots that follow will have different skins to distinguish them. Jill (Girl with ponytail), Maxim (Guy wearing medic gear), Grace (Girl with NVGs), Adam (Guy with red eyes)

After the early access release what then?
After the EA release, we plan to optimize the codes we created and update any assets such as walls, doors, etc. We also plan to start on the Campaign as well as Expeditions. We also are considering another game mode called Raids

What is this Raid game mode?
Raid is a game mode where you and a few AI soldiers assault areas such as bases and outposts. Giving the feeling of action and intensity.

Should I expect bugs and issues?
Yes, please expect bugs/issues to happen because Unity's Navmesh tends to bake the same navmesh from one map to another and cause pathing issues to the AI, you can cheese the infected by staying under them and receive no damage. If there are more bugs, please report them via our Discord server or any other social media. 


Stay Safe
-Spearhead Interactive Director

Directors note: When I release this game, I should note that I will be leaving for 3 months to go to military BootCamp and then begin my service for the government! I will see you then.

notes.title: Prepare to be amazed!
notes.content:
Hunter Project: Operation Survive is planned to be showcased as a demo showing an early build of the previous state of the game! 

The developer will provide answers to the questions you may have. Be sure to stop by and ask to allow us to know what would interest you.

The broadcast will begin on Wednesday, June 15 at around 3:00 PM and end around 5:30 PM. The broadcaster will play the game as it currently is and analyze things that will be changed or stay the same. The developers will also explain the story and vision that the game is going for in terms of gameplay and visuals. 








Things different from the "trailer" 

 Lighting
 Menu
 Audio
 Maps







Note:

From what you see on the video is what is going to be shown, the game being showcased may not reflect the final game. The game is still a WIP and the models and systems will be subject to change. 


What is to come
A fully fleshed-out design of characters and enemies, more enemy types, and a third-party faction. Friendly AI that will fight with you and follow you. Prepare for war Trooper
